sections.markdown:
# Effective Consumption — KPI scorecard

Live DQL for the Effective Consumption model: **Signals · Automation · Foundation · Engagement**, rolled up into an **Overall Effective Score (OES)**. Default window is **30 days**.

Each KPI below is tagged: **✅ computable** (Grail-only), **🟡 partial** (needs ticketing or an entity-coverage definition), **🔧 definition-gated** (needs the customer's required-tag / id-env-owner standard). Partial and gated KPIs are excluded from the OES denominator — never scored as 0.

> **Gen3-first:** the Foundation KPIs are reframed to platform-native surfaces (host groups, segments, buckets, source tags). The absence of classic management zones / classic tags is *not* a gap.

## 1 · Self-Service Score  ✅  *(SSU ⊕ COC, blended + scale-gated)*
Participation and ownership evenness of config changes, gated against a 20%-of-eligible target.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.query_executions
| filter isNull(client.internal_service_context)
| summarize totalEligibleUsers = countDistinct(user.id)
| append [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "AUDIT_EVENT" and isNull(authentication.token)
    | filter isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
    | filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN", "system"})
    | summarize changes = count(), by:{user.id}
    | summarize totalChanges = sum(changes),
                participatingUsers = countDistinct(user.id),
                hhi = sum(changes*changes) / (sum(changes) * sum(changes))
  ]
| summarize totalEligibleUsers = max(toDouble(totalEligibleUsers)),
            totalChanges = max(toDouble(totalChanges)),
            participatingUsers = max(toDouble(participatingUsers)),
            hhi = max(toDouble(hhi))
| fieldsAdd hhi_Normalized = if(participatingUsers <= 1, 1.0, else: (hhi - 1/participatingUsers) / (1 - 1/participatingUsers))
| fieldsAdd participationRate = participatingUsers/totalEligibleUsers
| fieldsAdd participationRateCapped = if(participationRate > 1, 1, else: participationRate)
| fieldsAdd evenness = 1 - hhi_Normalized
| fieldsAdd selfServiceScore = round((0.3*participationRateCapped + 0.7*evenness)*100),
            targetUsers = totalEligibleUsers*.2,
            dailyChanges = round(totalChanges)/30
| fieldsAdd scaleScore = if(participatingUsers > targetUsers, 1, else: participatingUsers/targetUsers)
| fieldsAdd selfServiceTargetScore = round(selfServiceScore * scaleScore)

sections.markdown:
## 2 · COC — Config Ownership Concentration  ✅
Herfindahl index over config changes per user. Low = distributed (target ≤ 0.4). `OwnershipIndex = 1 − COC` feeds OES.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "AUDIT_EVENT" and isNull(authentication.token)
| filter isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
| filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN", "system"})
| summarize changes = count(), by:{user.id}
| summarize COC = sum(changes*changes)/(sum(changes)*sum(changes)),
            participants = countDistinct(user.id),
            totalChanges = sum(changes)
| fieldsAdd OwnershipIndex = 1 - COC

sections.markdown:
## 2a · Outlier fence — actor-distribution guard *(run before COC / SSU / QEI)*
A single automation actor running under a user identity (terraform-runner, monaco service account) can out-change every human combined and make HHI meaningless. Fence per-actor change counts at **median + 3×IQR**. Actors above the fence: name them in a side-note, **exclude them from the human-engagement math** (COC / SSU / self-service) and **count them toward the automation story** (CCS below) — they are usually misclassified config-as-code, not a self-service participant. If nothing trips, report "no outliers fenced" as method color — don't invent one. The same fence applies to any hotspot list (top config types, top buckets, top users by change count).

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind=="AUDIT_EVENT" and isNull(authentication.token) and isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
| filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN","system"})
| summarize changes=count(), by:{user.id}
| summarize users=count(), p25=percentile(changes,25), p50=percentile(changes,50), p75=percentile(changes,75), maxChanges=max(changes)
| fieldsAdd outlierFence = p50 + 3*(p75 - p25)

sections.markdown:
## 2b · CCS — Config-as-Code Share  ✅
The automation-side complement to COC: the share of **all** settings changes that are **token-driven** (Terraform / Monaco / API). Target **≥ 0.7** — a tenant under source control, with humans making declarative-drift changes on top. Low CCS + high human change volume = a click-ops estate: every change manual, unreviewed, unreproducible. Secondary read on `tokenActors`: ≥ 5 ✅ · 2–4 💡 · 0–1 ⚠️ (no config-as-code practice); actors fenced by the outlier guard above join this count. Feeds the **Automation** pillar — see the OES tile.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind=="AUDIT_EVENT" and isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
| filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN","system"})
| summarize total=count(), tokenDriven=countIf(isNotNull(authentication.token)),
    tokenActors=countDistinct(if(isNotNull(authentication.token), user.id)),
    humanActors=countDistinct(if(isNull(authentication.token), user.id))
| fieldsAdd CCS = round(toDouble(tokenDriven)/toDouble(total), decimals:3)

sections.markdown:
## 3 · WFR — Workflow Follow-Through Rate  ✅
Terminal executions only, deduped by execution id. Target ≥ 85%.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind=="WORKFLOW_EVENT" and event.type=="WORKFLOW_EXECUTION" and dt.automation_engine.state.is_final==true
| dedup {dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| summarize triggered=count(), completed=countIf(dt.automation_engine.state=="SUCCESS")
| fieldsAdd WFR = round(100.0*toDouble(completed)/toDouble(triggered), decimals:1)

sections.markdown:
## 4 · WOS — Workflow Ownership & Success  ✅
Ownership approximated by distinct runners per workflow; success = completed/triggered; composite = geometric mean.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind=="WORKFLOW_EVENT" and event.type=="WORKFLOW_EXECUTION" and dt.automation_engine.state.is_final==true
| dedup {dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| summarize triggered=count(), completed=countIf(dt.automation_engine.state=="SUCCESS"),
    workflows=countDistinct(dt.automation_engine.workflow.id),
    actors=countDistinct(dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.actor)
| fieldsAdd WOS_Success = toDouble(completed)/toDouble(triggered)
| fieldsAdd WOS_Ownership = if(toDouble(actors)/toDouble(workflows)>1.0, 1.0, else: toDouble(actors)/toDouble(workflows))
| fieldsAdd WOS_Composite = round(sqrt(WOS_Ownership*WOS_Success), decimals:3)

sections.markdown:
## 5 · PUI — Problem Usefulness Index  ✅
0.4·root-cause + 0.3·impact>1-entity + 0.3·actionable. Target ≥ 0.7. Near-zero impact-multi ⇒ shallow topology or per-entity static thresholds.

input.value:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| dedup {display_id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| fieldsAdd rc = if(isNotNull(root_cause_entity_id) or isNotNull(root_cause.smartscape_entity.id), 1.0, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd im = if(arraySize(affected_entity_ids) > 1 or arraySize(smartscape.affected_entity.ids) > 1, 1.0, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd ac = if(dt.davis.mute.status=="NOT_MUTED" and dt.davis.is_duplicate==false and dt.davis.is_frequent_event==false, 1.0, else: 0.0)
| summarize problems=count(), rootCauseRate=avg(rc), impactMultiRate=avg(im), actionableRate=avg(ac)
| fieldsAdd PUI = round((0.4*rootCauseRate + 0.3*impactMultiRate + 0.3*actionableRate), decimals:3)

sections.markdown:
## 6 · QEI — Query/Active Engagement Index  ✅
**Sustained active engagement**, not bucket diversity: of the humans who query at all, what share do so regularly (≥10 distinct days). Answers 'is the data actually worked, or is it shelfware?' Also weigh sustained users against estate size (a handful of sustained users on a huge estate = shelfware even if the rate looks OK).

input.value:
fetch dt.system.query_executions
| filter isNull(client.internal_service_context) and query_pool != "AUTOMATION"
| summarize activeDays=countDistinct(toString(bin(timestamp,1d))), queries=count(), by:{user.id}
| summarize activeUsers=count(), sustainedUsers=countIf(activeDays>=10),
    oneOrTwoDayUsers=countIf(activeDays<=2), medianActiveDays=median(activeDays), totalQueries=sum(queries)
| fieldsAdd QEI = round(toDouble(sustainedUsers)/toDouble(activeUsers), decimals:3)

sections.markdown:
## 6b · EUB — Expected-Users Baseline  🟡 *(persona-count estimate)*
QEI says what share of active users is sustained; EUB asks the prior question — **is the active population the right size for this estate?** The estate's shape implies an expected persona population; compare it to the actual distinct query users (the QEI denominator). Default assumptions (override via `personaCounts` in `standards.<tenant>.json`): 0.3 developers per service · 1 SRE per host group · 1 owner per web/mobile app · 0.5 SRE per SLO · 2 cloud admins per cloud connector · +2 security if AppSec is billed. **Bands:** actual/expected < 30% ⚠️ platform closed to its consumers · 30–70% 💡 opportunity to open access · 70–130% ✅ platform open, personas on it · > 130% baseline under-estimates this org (note as color, don't over-credit). An **estimate** — say so in the report. Context for QEI, **never an OES input**.

input.value:
fetch dt.entity.service | summarize n=count() | fieldsAdd entityType="service"
| append [fetch dt.entity.host_group | summarize n=count() | fieldsAdd entityType="host_group"]
| append [fetch dt.entity.application | summarize n=count() | fieldsAdd entityType="web_application"]
| append [fetch dt.entity.mobile_application | summarize n=count() | fieldsAdd entityType="mobile_application"]
| fields entityType, n

sections.title: EUB — estate shape vs actual users

sections.markdown:
## 7 · Noise / Friction  🟡
Duplicate / frequent / muted / under-maintenance shares. NoisePenalty (OES) = duplicate + frequent rates. Reopen / ticket-per-problem / TSG need external systems (N/A).

input.value:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| dedup {display_id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| summarize problems=count(),
    duplicates=countIf(dt.davis.is_duplicate==true),
    frequent=countIf(dt.davis.is_frequent_event==true),
    muted=countIf(dt.davis.mute.status!="NOT_MUTED"),
    underMaint=countIf(maintenance.is_under_maintenance==true)
| fieldsAdd duplicateRate=round(100.0*toDouble(duplicates)/toDouble(problems),decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd frequentRate=round(100.0*toDouble(frequent)/toDouble(problems),decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd maintenanceRate=round(100.0*toDouble(underMaint)/toDouble(problems),decimals:1)

sections.markdown:
## 7b · Delivery — problem→automation lane (config × events)  ✅
Events only see workflows that *ran*; the configured davis-problem workflows may never fire. Paste their ids below (from the **Workflows** app, or `dtctl get workflows` where `trigger.eventTrigger.triggerConfiguration.type == "davis-problem"`). **Zero runs against a large problem count = a dead alerting→automation lane** — a finding neither config nor events shows alone. This also gives the **SQI workflow leg** (completed problem-triggered runs / total problems).

input.value:
fetch dt.davis.problems | dedup {display_id} | summarize totalProblems = count()
| append [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind=="WORKFLOW_EVENT" and event.type=="WORKFLOW_EXECUTION" and dt.automation_engine.state.is_final==true
    | filter in(dt.automation_engine.workflow.id, {"PASTE-DAVIS-PROBLEM-WORKFLOW-ID-1","PASTE-ID-2"})
    | dedup {dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.id}
    | summarize triggered=count(), completed=countIf(dt.automation_engine.state=="SUCCESS")
  ]
| summarize totalProblems=max(totalProblems), triggered=max(triggered), completed=max(completed)
| fieldsAdd ProblemAttachedWFR_pct = round(100.0*toDouble(completed)/toDouble(triggered), decimals:1)
| fieldsAdd SQI_workflow_leg_pct = round(100.0*toDouble(completed)/toDouble(totalProblems), decimals:2)

sections.markdown:
## 8 · Foundation — SCI from the standards file  🔧
Edit the required-key set to `requiredTagKeys.host` from `standards.<tenant>.json`. **A required key with no coverage returns no row** — count it as 0 when averaging (do not average present-only rows). **Gen3-first:** require source tags / host groups / segments, never classic management zones.

input.value:
fetch dt.entity.host
| summarize totalHosts = count()
| append [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | expand tags | parse tags, "LD:key ':' LD:val"
    | filter in(key, {"Team","dt.owner","environment"})   // <- requiredTagKeys.host
    | summarize hostsWithKey = countDistinct(id), by:{key}
  ]

sections.markdown:
## 9 · Trends — direction, not just level
Weekly trajectories of the headline KPIs. A stable-but-low line = chronic (fix the design); a falling line = regression (find what changed). **Always read the ratio next to its per-week count** — ratios on small weekly samples (e.g. config participants) are noisy.

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind=="WORKFLOW_EVENT" and event.type=="WORKFLOW_EXECUTION" and dt.automation_engine.state.is_final==true
| dedup {dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| fieldsAdd ok = if(dt.automation_engine.state=="SUCCESS",1.0,else:0.0)
| summarize triggered=count(), completed=sum(ok), by:{week=bin(timestamp,7d)}
| fieldsAdd WFR_pct = round(100.0*completed/toDouble(triggered),decimals:1)
| sort week asc

sections.markdown:
## 10 · OES — Overall Effective Score  ✅
One-query rollup of the computable pillars. Foundation is **excluded** (definition-gated) and the denominator reweighted; NoisePenalty applied multiplicatively. **Weights use the source code block** (Signals 0.35 · Automation 0.35 · Foundation 0.20 · Engagement 0.10); edit inline to switch to the prose weights (0.35 / 0.20 / 0.10 / 0.35). Grade: A≥85 B≥70 C≥50 D<50.

**Automation composition (upgraded 2026-07-14):** `Automation = mean(WFR, WOS, CCS)` — CCS folds the config-as-code half of automation into the pillar; a tenant whose workflows succeed but whose every config change is click-ops is not automation-mature. A deliberate change from the source model — flag it in the method note alongside the weight-profile choice (`targets.includeCCS`, default true; drop CCS from the mean to revert).

input.value:
fetch dt.system.query_executions
| filter isNull(client.internal_service_context)
| summarize eligibleUsers = countDistinct(user.id)
| append [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "AUDIT_EVENT" and isNull(authentication.token)
    | filter isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
    | filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN", "system"})
    | summarize changes = count(), by:{user.id}
    | summarize configurators = countDistinct(user.id),
                hhi = sum(changes*changes) / (sum(changes) * sum(changes))
  ]
| append [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "AUDIT_EVENT" and isNotNull(details.dt.settings.object_summary)
    | filterOut in(user.id, {"UNKNOWN", "system"})
    | summarize ccsTotal = count(), ccsTokenDriven = countIf(isNotNull(authentication.token))
  ]
| append [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind=="WORKFLOW_EVENT" and event.type=="WORKFLOW_EXECUTION" and dt.automation_engine.state.is_final==true
    | dedup {dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
    | summarize wfTriggered=count(), wfCompleted=countIf(dt.automation_engine.state=="SUCCESS"),
        wfWorkflows=countDistinct(dt.automation_engine.workflow.id),
        wfActors=countDistinct(dt.automation_engine.workflow_execution.actor)
  ]
| append [
    fetch dt.davis.problems
    | dedup {display_id}, sort:{timestamp desc}
    | fieldsAdd rc = if(isNotNull(root_cause_entity_id) or isNotNull(root_cause.smartscape_entity.id),1.0,else:0.0)
    | fieldsAdd im = if(arraySize(affected_entity_ids)>1 or arraySize(smartscape.affected_entity.ids)>1,1.0,else:0.0)
    | fieldsAdd ac = if(dt.davis.mute.status=="NOT_MUTED" and dt.davis.is_duplicate==false and dt.davis.is_frequent_event==false,1.0,else:0.0)
    | summarize problems=count(), rootCauseRate=avg(rc), impactMultiRate=avg(im), actionableRate=avg(ac),
        dupRate=avg(if(dt.davis.is_duplicate==true,1.0,else:0.0)),
        freqRate=avg(if(dt.davis.is_frequent_event==true,1.0,else:0.0))
  ]
| append [
    fetch dt.system.query_executions
    | filter isNull(client.internal_service_context) and query_pool != "AUTOMATION"
    | summarize activeDays=countDistinct(toString(bin(timestamp,1d))), by:{user.id}
    | summarize activeUsers=count(), sustainedUsers=countIf(activeDays>=10)
  ]
| summarize eligibleUsers=max(eligibleUsers), configurators=max(configurators), hhi=max(hhi),
    ccsTotal=max(ccsTotal), ccsTokenDriven=max(ccsTokenDriven),
    wfTriggered=max(wfTriggered), wfCompleted=max(wfCompleted), wfWorkflows=max(wfWorkflows), wfActors=max(wfActors),
    problems=max(problems), rootCauseRate=max(rootCauseRate), impactMultiRate=max(impactMultiRate), actionableRate=max(actionableRate),
    dupRate=max(dupRate), freqRate=max(freqRate), activeUsers=max(activeUsers), sustainedUsers=max(sustainedUsers)
| fieldsAdd SSU = toDouble(configurators)/toDouble(eligibleUsers)
| fieldsAdd OwnershipIndex = 1.0 - hhi
| fieldsAdd CCS = toDouble(ccsTokenDriven)/toDouble(ccsTotal)
| fieldsAdd WFR = toDouble(wfCompleted)/toDouble(wfTriggered)
| fieldsAdd WOS = sqrt( (if(toDouble(wfActors)/toDouble(wfWorkflows)>1.0,1.0,else:toDouble(wfActors)/toDouble(wfWorkflows))) * (toDouble(wfCompleted)/toDouble(wfTriggered)) )
| fieldsAdd PUI = 0.4*rootCauseRate + 0.3*impactMultiRate + 0.3*actionableRate
| fieldsAdd QEI = toDouble(sustainedUsers)/toDouble(activeUsers)
| fieldsAdd NoisePenalty = if(dupRate+freqRate>0.5,0.5,else:dupRate+freqRate)
| fieldsAdd Signals_idx = PUI
| fieldsAdd Automation_idx = (WFR + WOS + CCS)/3.0
| fieldsAdd Engagement_idx = QEI
| fieldsAdd OES = round( (0.35*Signals_idx + 0.35*Automation_idx + 0.10*Engagement_idx) / 0.80 * (1.0-NoisePenalty) * 100 )
| fieldsAdd Grade = if(OES>=85,"A",else:if(OES>=70,"B",else:if(OES>=50,"C",else:"D")))
| fields SSU, OwnershipIndex, CCS, WFR, WOS, PUI, QEI, NoisePenalty, Signals_idx, Automation_idx, Engagement_idx, OES, Grade
